answer: Home pickup isn't available in Texas, so you would need to book an appraisal appointment at a store instead. For that appointment, bring a physical photo ID for every owner on the title (mobile IDs are accepted only in Virginia), the current registration, all keys and remotes, the title if you have it, and the odometer disclosure statement, form NW-ODO-2. Because the car is leased, also bring your dealer payoff quote, and plan for about an hour. The help center articles here don't cover other lease-specific steps, so please contact a store for those details.
